note: Useful leads and optional ideas preserved with status. Nothing here is a minimum obligation; adoption must be justified later. Leads are not requirements and none were executed.

leads.title: OME-Zarr 0.5 write/export for derived images
leads.detail: NGFF 0.5 axes/units/coordinateTransformations + omero channel windows give a standard home for derived rasters and calibration (S1). tifffile can write NGFF 0.5 multiscales (S5/S6 2026.5.2 entry); QuPath 0.6+ reads/writes OME-Zarr (S12).

leads.title: Build on napari (embed or plugin) as fallback
leads.detail: napari already implements display/data separation, lazy arrays, multiscale, shapes, units (S2-S4). Fallback if custom canvas work overruns; cost is dependency and version churn.

leads.title: QuPath as platform alternative
leads.detail: Field-tested project/backup/relocation/export machinery (S12-S14); strongest if whole-slide breadth becomes a requirement; JVM stack mismatched to this team.

leads.title: image.sc forum threads as community evidence channel
leads.detail: tifffile issue #54 originated from an image.sc discussion (S11); forum threads often precede GitHub issues for calibration/axes questions — monitor for the team's instruments.

leads.title: CZI and other vendor formats
leads.detail: Deferred per support boundary (tifffile does not read CZI; S5). Options if needed later: aicspylibczi/bioio readers behind the Reader service interface; each addition needs its own calibration fixtures (V6 pattern).

leads.title: GPU-assisted rendering/decoding
leads.detail: Envelope marks GPU optional. Keep renderer path abstract (VisPy-like) so GPU LUT/windowing can be added; do not gate v1 on it.

leads.title: GeoJSON external interop caveat
leads.detail: RFC 7946 defines GeoJSON positions as WGS84 lon/lat; microscopy tools (incl. QuPath) use plain pixel x/y (S13). Our GeoJSON export should carry an explicit non-geographic CRS note in the manifest; a compliant-lonlat mode is a later, tested addition. RFC text itself not fetched this stage.
leads.status: design note, UNVERIFIED against RFC text

leads.title: ITK/SimpleITK physical-coordinate model for future registration
leads.detail: Origin/spacing/direction-cosine model would be the precedent if registration becomes in-scope; not investigated this stage.

leads.title: Assisted segmentation (Cellpose/StarDist/InstanSeg)
leads.detail: QuPath ecosystem evidence of demand and integration patterns (S12 v0.6.0 InstanSeg). Later alternative if annotation throughput becomes the bottleneck; must remain assist-only with provenance labels.

leads.title: OMERO/cloud exchange
leads.detail: Out of scope for v1 (bundle exchange via shared storage). NGFF's HTTP-object-store orientation (S1) keeps a later cloud path open without schema change.

leads.title: tifffile asxarray/coords for axis metadata probing
leads.detail: tifffile 2026.5.2 added asxarray and TiffPageSeries mpp/coords/units properties (S5/S6) — candidate implementation detail for the import inspector; verify behavior on the team's files.

leads.title: napari-layer undo/redo behavior
leads.detail: Brief requires undo/redo; napari layers provide some undo behavior but this was not verified this stage (S4 does not document it). Design keeps undo in our own op stack (C6) regardless; do not rely on unverified library behavior.

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: A1 tile-latency adequacy of tifffile/zarr on the team's real 3 GB files
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence_state: consistent with design (S5 tile/page/zarr reads) but no benchmark executed

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: A2 shared-storage (NFS/SMB) save-atomicity acceptable with temp-in-dir + backups
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence_state: rename(2) documents atomicity and NFS caveat (S15); W3 is local-only

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: A3 instrument calibration trustworthy after one recorded import confirmation
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence_state: tifffile #319 shows readers can change unit semantics (S7-S9)
